auditoria.erro: role/doubt: there is no 'CDQL'; CouchDB has Mango and MapReduce views, which cannot rank BM25. Full-text needs the Lucene-based Nouveau or Clouseau search service with its own analyzers. doubt should be true.

final.role: Lucene full-text search inside CouchDB via Nouveau/Clouseau indexes, not MapReduce views
final.evidence: Leverage CouchDB’s native query language with custom analyzers (e.g., via MapReduce) for BM25-like keyword search on frontmatter.

auditoria.nota: Busca dentro do próprio CouchDB do hub é possível, mas exige o serviço Lucene (Nouveau, em Java) ao lado do banco; MapReduce sozinho não dá ranking.
